_說明: THC6（Tree House C6）文法、聽力、發音與會話。cards＝課本 Grammar 頁小卡；questions＝文法題（choice 選擇、order 排句子）；listening＝用課本例句出的聽力題（lfill、lpick、lorder），加上發音聽辨（lpick、有 label）；phonics＝課本 Phonics 頁（例字用 [ ] 標出發這個音的字母）；talk＝課本 Conversation（會話站）。a＝正確選項位置（從 0 開始），App 會打亂選項順序。

U1.title: stop / keep Ving · Present Continuous · Adverbs of Degree
U1.zh: stop／keep 後面接 V-ing；現在進行式：現在正在做的事；程度副詞：really、very 讓副詞更強
rules: stop ＋ V-ing：停止做某件事
Susie stopped skating at 3:15.
keep ＋ V-ing：持續做某件事
Becky and Susie will keep playing chess.
現在進行式：am / is / are ＋ V-ing
The dog is digging a hole.
否定：am not / isn't / aren't ＋ V-ing
Paul and Wally aren't having fun.
really / very ＋ 副詞：程度更強
Alice was throwing the balls really fast.
形容詞 → 副詞：careless → carelessly
Kate is skating very carelessly.
phrases: really fast　very carefully　very carelessly　really well　very slowly
mistakes: Susie stopped skate at 3:15.
Susie stopped skating at 3:15.
stop 後面接 V-ing
They will keep play chess.
They will keep playing chess.
keep 後面接 V-ing
The dog digging a hole.
The dog is digging a hole.
進行式不能少了 is
Kate is skating very careless.
Kate is skating very carelessly.
形容動作要用副詞 carelessly

U2.title: good at / terrible at Ving · Sensory Verbs · as / when
U2.zh: good at／terrible at 後面接 V-ing；感官動詞＋形容詞／like＋名詞；as／when：當……的時候
rules: good at ＋ V-ing：擅長做某件事
Alice is good at drawing clothes.
terrible at ＋ V-ing：很不會做某件事
The worker is terrible at mopping the floor.
感官動詞 ＋ 形容詞：look / smell / sound / taste / feel
The man's cake tasted bad.
感官動詞 ＋ like ＋ 名詞：摸起來像……
The socks felt like rocks.
as：一邊……一邊……（兩件事同時進行）
Chuck's dad will talk to the vendor as he tries on the hat.
when：正在做 A 的時候，B 發生了
Grandma was talking on her cell phone when the boy jumped over her.
phrases: look cute　smell good　sound great　taste bad　feel soft　feel like rocks
mistakes: Alice is good at draw clothes.
Alice is good at drawing clothes.
at 後面的動作要加 -ing
The cake tasted badly.
The cake tasted bad.
感官動詞後面用形容詞，不用副詞
The socks felt rocks.
The socks felt like rocks.
後面接名詞要加 like
He will talk as he will try on the hat.
He will talk as he tries on the hat.
講未來時，as／when 後面用現在式

U3.title: Comparative & Superlative Adjectives · before / after · Past Continuous: while
U3.zh: 比較級（比較兩個）與最高級（三個以上最……）；before／after：在……之前／之後；while：正在做某事的時候
rules: 比較級：形容詞-er ＋ than（兩個比）
Alice and Susie were faster than Chuck.
最高級：the ＋ 形容詞-est（三個以上最……）
Today must be the hottest day so far this summer.
before／after ＋ 名詞（介系詞）
Tim usually misses the bus before school.
before／after ＋ 主詞＋動詞（連接詞）
Wally fed the cat after he watched the movie.
while ＋ 主詞 was / were ＋ V-ing：正在做的時候
Pam called Becky while she was lying on the bed.
長的形容詞：more ＋ 形容詞／the most ＋ 形容詞
Becky is more honest than Wally.
phrases: fast → faster → the fastest　heavy → heavier → the heaviest　hot → hotter → the hottest　good → better → the best
mistakes: Tim's bag is heavyer than Susie's.
Tim's bag is heavier than Susie's.
y 結尾：改 i 再加 -er
Today is the hotest day.
Today is the hottest day.
hot 要重複 t：hottest
Alice is more fast than Chuck.
Alice is faster than Chuck.
短的形容詞直接加 -er，不用 more
Pam called Becky while she lay on the bed.
Pam called Becky while she was lying on the bed.
while 後面用 was / were ＋ V-ing

U4.title: Pronouns: one, some, a lot, there · like Ving / Ving is (adj.) · How long?: for / until
U4.zh: 用 one／some／a lot／there 代替前面說過的東西；動名詞 V-ing 當主詞或受詞；How long? 用 for（多久）／until（直到）回答
rules: one：代替前面說過的「一個」
Did the wizard wash a fish? Yes, he washed one.
some／a lot：代替「一些／很多」
Were there any eggs on the wide bench? Yes, there were some there.
like ＋ V-ing：喜歡做某事
The dragon likes smelling flowers.
V-ing ＋ is ＋ 形容詞：做某事是……的
Fighting the monster is dangerous.
for ＋ 一段時間：持續多久
The soldiers will exercise for two hours.
until ＋ 時間／事件：一直到……為止
The queen will ride until she finds the dragon.
phrases: for a short time　for two hours　until four o'clock　until she finds the dragon
mistakes: Did he wash a fish? Yes, he washed it a fish.
Did he wash a fish? Yes, he washed one.
用 one 代替，不要重複
Fight the monster is dangerous.
Fighting the monster is dangerous.
動作當主詞要加 -ing
They exercised until two hours.
They exercised for two hours.
一段時間用 for
She will ride until she will find the dragon.
She will ride until she finds the dragon.
講未來時，until 後面用現在式

U5.title: may / must · Future Tense · Comparative & Superlative Adverbs
U5.zh: may＝可以／也許，must＝必須；未來式 will 與 be going to；副詞的比較級與最高級（跑得比較快、跳得最高）
rules: may ＋ 原形動詞：可以（允許）
Who may go for a hike?
must ＋ 原形動詞：必須
What must the dad bear do? He must clean the house.
will ＋ 原形動詞：將會
The witch will hurt her toe.
be going to ＋ 原形動詞：快要／打算
The cat is going to be in the tree.
副詞比較級：動詞 ＋ 副詞-er ＋ than
The centipede ran faster than the cockroach.
副詞最高級：動詞 ＋ the ＋ 副詞-est
Which frog jumped the highest?
phrases: fast → faster → the fastest　high → higher → the highest　carefully → more carefully → the most carefully　well → better → the best
mistakes: He must cleans the house.
He must clean the house.
must 後面用原形動詞
The witch will hurts her toe.
The witch will hurt her toe.
will 後面用原形動詞
The cat is going be in the tree.
The cat is going to be in the tree.
be going to 不能少了 to
Which frog jumped highest than the others?
Which frog jumped the highest?
三個以上比用 the ＋ 最高級

U6.title: Pronouns: one / it · Conjunctions: when / while · too…to / so…that…couldn't
U6.zh: one＝同一種的「一個」，it＝前面說過的「那一個」；when／while：當……的時候；too…to／so…that…couldn't：太……以致於不能
rules: one：任何一個（不是特定的）
Who had a plan? The eagle had one.
it：前面說過的「那一個」（特定的）
Will the giant want the heart? Yes, he will want it.
正在做（was ＋ V-ing）＋ when ＋ 突然發生（過去式）
The prince was bouncing a ball when he fell down.
過去式 ＋ while ＋ 正在做（was ＋ V-ing）
The duck hit the castle while it was flying.
too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to ＋ 原形動詞：太……而不能……
The giant is too tired to talk.
so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that ＋ 主詞 ＋ couldn't ＋ 原形動詞
The rabbit was so scared that it couldn't move.
phrases: too tired to talk　too heavy to carry　so scared that it couldn't move　so hungry that he couldn't sleep
mistakes: Who had a plan? The eagle had it.
Who had a plan? The eagle had one.
「一個計畫」（沒有特定的）用 one
The giant is too tired to talking.
The giant is too tired to talk.
to 後面用原形動詞
The rabbit was so scared that it can't move.
The rabbit was so scared that it couldn't move.
過去的事用 couldn't
The prince bounced a ball when he was falling down.
The prince was bouncing a ball when he fell down.
長的動作用 was ＋ V-ing，突然發生的用過去式

U7.title: Possessive Pronouns · let / make (someone) (v.) · Past Tense: time phrases
U7.zh: 所有格代名詞：mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs；let＝讓（允許），make＝叫、逼（一定要做）；過去式＋時間片語
rules: 所有格代名詞＝所有格＋東西
It's Pam and Becky's tape. It's theirs.
問句：Is / Was ＋ 東西 ＋ 某人's?
Was the extra umbrella Kate's? No, it wasn't hers.
let ＋ 人 ＋ 原形動詞：讓某人做（允許）
Tim will let Wally ride his bike.
make ＋ 人 ＋ 原形動詞：叫某人一定要做
Becky's mom made Kate get dressed.
過去式 ＋ on ＋ 日期
Becky interrupted her mom on March 22.
When did ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形動詞?
When did Alice lock the window?
phrases: my → mine　your → yours　his → his　her → hers　our → ours　their → theirs
mistakes: It's Pam and Becky's tape. It's their.
It's Pam and Becky's tape. It's theirs.
後面沒有名詞要用 theirs
Tim will let Wally to ride his bike.
Tim will let Wally ride his bike.
let ＋ 人 ＋ 原形動詞（不加 to）
Mom made Kate got dressed.
Mom made Kate get dressed.
make ＋ 人 ＋ 原形動詞
When did Alice locked the window?
When did Alice lock the window?
did 後面用原形動詞

U8.title: Present Perfect Tense: seen · Conjunctions: because / so · How often?: time phrases
U8.zh: 現在完成式 have／has seen：看過（經驗）；because＝因為（原因），so＝所以（結果）；How often? 用頻率片語回答
rules: have / has ＋ seen：看過（從以前到現在的經驗）
The police officer has seen a parrot.
Have / Has ＋ 主詞 ＋ ever seen…?：你看過……嗎？
Have you ever seen a dog covered with leaves?
結果 ＋ because ＋ 原因
She is scared because she is having a nightmare.
原因 ＋ , so ＋ 結果
Alice was hot, so she took off her sweatshirt.
How often ＋ do / does ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形動詞?
How often do Paul and his dad eat junk food?
頻率片語：once / twice / three times ＋ a day / week / month
They eat junk food once a week.
phrases: once a week（一週一次）　twice a month（一個月兩次）　three times a day（一天三次）
mistakes: The police officer has saw a parrot.
The police officer has seen a parrot.
have / has 後面用 seen
Have you ever see a dog covered with leaves?
Have you ever seen a dog covered with leaves?
Have … ever seen
Alice was hot, because she took off her sweatshirt.
Alice was hot, so she took off her sweatshirt.
後面是結果 → so
They eat junk food one a week.
They eat junk food once a week.
一次＝once

U9.title: If…, will… · If…, would… · (someone) heard that / said that
U9.zh: If…, will…：真的可能發生的條件；If…were…, would…：不可能或想像的事；heard that／said that：轉述聽到的、別人說的話
rules: If ＋ 現在式, 主詞 ＋ will ＋ 原形動詞（真的可能發生）
If Paul is mad, he will stomp on the soldiers.
will 那一句也可以放前面：… will … if …
What will Pam do if she wins the game?
If ＋ 主詞 ＋ were, 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形動詞（想像的）
If Paul were a soldier, he would drive a truck.
想像的事：I／he／she 都用 were
He would carry the dragon boat if he were really strong.
主詞 ＋ heard that ＋ 句子：聽說……
Alice heard that Pam bought a new model.
主詞 ＋ said that ＋ 句子：某人說……
Paul said that his dad met the king.
phrases: If he doesn't have any…　I would love it if I were him.　I heard that he's interested in reptiles.
mistakes: If Paul will be mad, he will stomp on the soldiers.
If Paul is mad, he will stomp on the soldiers.
if 那一句用現在式
If Paul was a soldier, he will drive a truck.
If Paul were a soldier, he would drive a truck.
想像的事：were ＋ would
I would love it if I am him.
I would love it if I were him.
想像的事用 were
Alice heard that Pam buys a new model yesterday.
Alice heard that Pam bought a new model.
過去的事用過去式

sounds.name: -ar-
sounds.rule: ar 在字中間或重音的地方唸 /ɑr/，嘴巴張大像「啊」再捲舌

sounds.name: w+ar-
sounds.rule: w 後面的 ar 不唸 /ɑr/，要唸 /ɔr/，像 or 的音

sounds.name: -ar
sounds.rule: 字尾不是重音的 ar 唸輕輕的 /ɚ/，跟 -er 一樣

sounds.name: -air
sounds.rule: air 唸 /ɛr/，像「ㄝ」再捲舌

sounds.name: -are
sounds.rule: are 在字尾也唸 /ɛr/，跟 air 一樣（e 不發音）

sounds.name: -ear
sounds.rule: 有些 ear 唸 /ɛr/：bear、pear、wear（但 hear、near 唸 /ɪr/，U4 會學）

sounds.name: -er-
sounds.rule: er 在重音的地方唸 /ɝ/，嘴巴小小、舌頭捲起來

sounds.name: -er
sounds.rule: 字尾不是重音的 er 唸輕輕的 /ɚ/，比較級的 -er 也是這個音

sounds.name: -ear
sounds.rule: 大部分的 ear 唸 /ɪr/，像「一」再捲舌（U2 的 bear、pear 是例外）

sounds.name: -eer
sounds.rule: eer 唸 /ɪr/

sounds.name: -ere
sounds.rule: ere 在字尾也常唸 /ɪr/（e 不發音）

sounds.name: -ir-
sounds.rule: ir 唸 /ɝ/，跟 er、ur 一樣

sounds.name: -ire
sounds.rule: ire 唸 /aɪr/，像字母 I 再加捲舌（e 不發音）

sounds.name: -ur-
sounds.rule: ur 也唸 /ɝ/

sounds.name: -ure
sounds.rule: ure 唸 /jʊr/ 或 /ʊr/，像「優兒」（e 不發音）

sounds.name: -or-
sounds.rule: or 唸 /ɔr/，嘴巴圓圓的「ㄛ」再捲舌

sounds.name: w+or-
sounds.rule: w 後面的 or 不唸 /ɔr/，要唸 /ɝ/，跟 er 一樣

sounds.name: -or
sounds.rule: 字尾不是重音的 or 唸輕輕的 /ɚ/

sounds.name: y-
sounds.rule: y 在字首是子音 /j/，像「一」快速滑過去

sounds.name: -y
sounds.rule: 短字的字尾 y（通常只有一個音節）唸 /aɪ/，像字母 I

sounds.name: --y
sounds.rule: 兩個音節以上的字尾 y 唸 /i/，像「一」

sounds.name: hard c
sounds.rule: c 後面接 a、o、u 或子音，唸 /k/

sounds.name: soft c
sounds.rule: c 後面接 e、i、y，唸 /s/

sounds.name: hard g
sounds.rule: g 後面接 a、o、u 或子音，唸 /g/

sounds.name: soft g
sounds.rule: g 後面接 e、i、y，常常唸 /dʒ/，像「ㄐ」（但 get、give、girl 例外）

U1.ex: stop 和 keep 後面接「動作」時，動作要加 -ing。stop＝不再做了；keep＝一直做下去。
eg: Susie 三點十五分停止溜冰。
Becky 和 Susie 會繼續下西洋棋。
Tim 一直努力到他贏為止。
U1.tip: 錯：stop skate／keep play → 對：stop skating／keep playing

U1.t: 現在進行式：現在「正在」做
U1.ex: 說「這一刻正在發生」的事。be 動詞跟著主詞變，動詞後面加 -ing。否定就在 be 動詞後面加 not。
eg: Paul 和 Wally 玩得不開心。
我正在試啊，但我沒辦法！
U1.tip: 動詞一定要加 -ing：is dig → is digging（dig 要重複 g）

U1.ex: 副詞告訴我們動作「怎麼做」：fast、carefully。前面再加 really 或 very，表示「非常」。
eg: Kate 溜冰溜得非常不小心。
我會試著更小心地溜冰。
U1.tip: 大部分形容詞加 -ly 變副詞（careful → carefully）；fast、hard 不變

U2.t: good at／terrible at ＋ V-ing：擅長／很不會
U2.en: good at Ving / terrible at Ving
U2.ex: at 後面接「動作」時，動作要加 -ing。good at＝很會；terrible at＝很不會。
U2.tip: 錯：good at draw → 對：good at drawing

U2.t: 感官動詞：看起來、聞起來、嚐起來……
U2.ex: look／smell／sound／taste／feel 說「感覺起來怎樣」。後面接形容詞；要接名詞時加 like。
eg: 那男人的蛋糕嚐起來不好吃。
這雙襪子摸起來像石頭。
這件洋裝看起來真可愛。
U2.tip: 後面用形容詞不用副詞：tasted bad（不是 badly）

U2.ex: as＝兩件事「同時」進行（一邊……一邊……）；when＝正在做一件事的時候，另一件事突然發生。
eg: {S:Chuck's dad} {B:will} {V:talk} to the vendor {C:as} {S:he} {V:tries on} the hat.
Chuck 的爸爸會一邊試戴帽子一邊和小販講話。
{S:Grandma} {B:was} {V:talking} on her cell phone {C:when} {S:the boy} {V:jumped} over her.
奶奶正在講手機的時候，男孩跳過了她。
{C:When} {S:you}{B:'re} {V:finished}, you can take the rest home.
妳試穿完之後，可以把其他的帶回家。
U2.tip: 講未來時，as／when 後面用現在式：as he tries（不是 will try）

U3.t: 比較級與最高級：比較「兩個」和「最……」
U3.ex: 兩個東西比：形容詞加 -er ＋ than。三個以上比出「最……」：the ＋ 形容詞加 -est。長的形容詞用 more／the most。
eg: Alice 和 Susie 比 Chuck 快。
Tim 的書包比 Susie 的書包重。
{S:Today} {B:must be} the {A:hottest} day so far this summer.
今天一定是這個夏天到目前為止最熱的一天。
U3.tip: y 結尾改 i（heavy → heavier）；短母音重複子音（hot → hotter → hottest）

U3.ex: before＝在……之前，after＝在……之後。後面可以接名詞（介系詞），也可以接一整句話（連接詞）。
eg: Tim 上學前常常沒趕上公車。
{S:Pam and Becky} {V:went} to the shopping center {C:after} church.
Pam 和 Becky 上完教堂後去購物中心。
Wally 看完電影之後餵了貓。
U3.tip: 講未來時，before／after 後面用現在式：before they play（不是 will play）

U3.t: 過去進行式＋while：正在做的時候
U3.ex: while 後面接「那時正在做」的事（was／were ＋ V-ing），另一件事就在那段時間裡發生。
eg: Becky 躺在床上的時候，Pam 打電話給她。
Tim 走路的時候做了什麼？
Tim 在拿飲料的時候，Wally 買了一條糖果棒。
U3.tip: lie → lying（ie 改 y 再加 -ing）

U4.t: 代名詞 one／some／a lot／there：不要重複說
U4.en: Pronouns: one, some, a lot, there
U4.ex: 前面已經說過的東西，回答時可以用 one（一個）、some（一些）、a lot（很多）代替；there 代替「那個地方」。
eg: Did the wizard wash a fish? Yes, {S:he} {V:washed} {O:one}.
那巫師洗魚了嗎？是的，他洗了一條。
Were there any eggs on the wide bench? Yes, there {B:were} {O:some} {P:there}.
那張寬板凳上有蛋嗎？是的，那裡有一些。
Do you have many cards? Yes, {S:I} {V:have} {O:a lot}.
你有很多卡片嗎？有，我有很多。
U4.tip: 一個 → one；一些 → some；很多 → a lot

U4.ex: 動作要當「東西」用時加 -ing：放在 like 後面，或放在句子最前面當主詞。
U4.tip: 當主詞的 V-ing 算「一件事」，後面用 is

U4.t: How long?：for 多久／until 直到
U4.ex: for ＋ 一段時間（兩小時、一下子）；until ＋ 結束的時間點或事情（四點、她找到龍）。
eg: 士兵們會運動兩個小時。
王后會一直騎馬，直到她找到龍。
U4.tip: 講未來時，until 後面用現在式：until she finds

U5.ex: may＝可以（被允許）；must＝必須（一定要）。後面都接原形動詞。
U5.tip: 錯：He must cleans → 對：He must clean

U5.ex: will＝將會（說未來、臨時決定）；be going to＝快要、已經打算好。後面都接原形動詞。
eg: 那女巫會傷到她的腳趾。
{S:The cat} {B:is going to} {V:be} in the tree.
那隻貓等一下會在樹上。
U5.tip: 否定：will not＝won't；It won't work on me.（對我沒效）

U5.t: 副詞的比較級與最高級
U5.ex: 比「動作」做得怎樣：兩個比用 副詞-er ＋ than；三個以上比用 the ＋ 副詞-est。-ly 的副詞用 more／the most。
eg: 那隻蜈蚣跑得比蟑螂快。
Becky 施咒比 Jimmy 小心。

U6.t: 代名詞 one／it：一個 vs. 那一個
U6.ex: one＝同一種東西的「隨便一個」；it＝前面說過的「那一個」（特定的）。
eg: Will the giant want the heart? Yes, {S:he} {B:will} {V:want} {O:it}.
巨人會想要那顆心嗎？會，他會想要它。
I don't have a pencil. Can I borrow {O:one}?
我沒有鉛筆，可以借我一枝嗎？
U6.tip: a ＋ 東西 → one；the ＋ 東西 → it

U6.ex: 正在做的長動作用 was／were ＋ V-ing，突然發生的短動作用過去式。when 接短動作，while 接長動作。
eg: 王子在拍球的時候跌倒了。
那隻鴨子在飛的時候撞到了城堡。
龍吼叫的時候我正在睡覺。
U6.tip: while 後面幾乎都是 was／were ＋ V-ing

U6.ex: 兩種說法意思一樣：too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to ＋ 動詞；so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that ＋ 主詞 ＋ couldn't ＋ 動詞。
f: that ＋ 主詞 ＋ couldn't ＋ 原形動詞
eg: 那巨人太累了，沒辦法說話。
那個箱子太重了，搬不動。
U6.tip: 過去的事用 couldn't；現在的事用 can't

U7.ex: 「誰的東西」後面不想再重複名詞時，用所有格代名詞：her umbrella → hers。
eg: 那是 Pam 和 Becky 的錄音帶，是她們的。
那把多的傘是 Kate 的嗎？不，不是她的。
Is this your umbrella? Yes, it's {S:mine}.
這是你的傘嗎？對，是我的。
U7.tip: 後面沒有名詞才用 mine／hers；後面有名詞用 my／her

U7.ex: let＝讓（允許，對方想做）；make＝叫、逼（一定要做）。人後面接原形動詞，不加 to。
eg: Tim 會讓 Wally 騎他的腳踏車。
Becky 的媽媽叫 Kate 把衣服穿好。
U7.tip: 錯：let Wally to ride → 對：let Wally ride

U7.ex: 說過去「什麼時候」做了某事：動詞用過去式，時間放句尾。日期用 on，時刻用 at；問句用 When did ＋ 原形動詞。
eg: Becky 在三月二十二日打斷了她媽媽說話。
Alice 什麼時候鎖了窗戶？
Alice 在午餐時間鎖了窗戶。
U7.tip: did 後面用原形：When did Alice lock（不是 locked）

U8.t: 現在完成式：have／has seen 看過
U8.ex: 說「從以前到現在，有沒有看過」的經驗：have／has ＋ seen。問「你曾經看過……嗎？」用 Have you ever seen…?
eg: 那位警察看過一隻鸚鵡。
{B:Have} {S:you} ever {V:seen} a dog covered with leaves?
你看過全身蓋滿樹葉的狗嗎？
{S:I} {B:have} never {V:seen} a weird riddle like that.
我從來沒看過那麼怪的謎語。
U8.tip: see → saw → seen；have／has 後面用 seen

U8.ex: because 後面接「原因」；so 後面接「結果」。同一件事兩種說法都可以。
eg: Becky 為什麼害怕？因為她在做惡夢。
Alice 很熱，所以脫掉了運動衫。
Wally 很沮喪，因為他又答錯了。
U8.tip: 中文說「因為……所以……」，英文 because 和 so 只能選一個

U8.ex: 問頻率用 How often；回答用 once（一次）、twice（兩次）、three times（三次）＋ a day／a week／a month。
eg: How often {B:do} {S:Paul and his dad} {V:eat} junk food?
Paul 和他爸爸多久吃一次垃圾食物？
U8.tip: 一次 once、兩次 twice，三次以上才用 times

U9.t: If…, will…：真的可能發生的條件
U9.ex: 說「如果這樣，就會那樣」，而且真的有可能發生：if 那一句用現在式，另一句用 will ＋ 原形動詞。
f: 主詞 ＋ will ＋ 原形動詞
主詞 ＋ will ＋ 原形動詞
eg: 如果 Paul 生氣，他會去踩那些士兵。
如果 Pam 贏了比賽，她會做什麼？
如果他沒有，可以自己去買。
U9.tip: if 那一句不用 will：If Paul is mad（不是 will be）

U9.ex: 說不可能、只是想像的事：if 那一句用 were（I／he／she 都用 were），另一句用 would ＋ 原形動詞。
f: 主詞 ＋ would ＋ 原形動詞
eg: 如果 Paul 是士兵，他會開卡車。
如果他非常強壯，他會扛起龍舟。
如果我是他，我會很喜歡。
U9.tip: 真的可能 → will；想像、不可能 → would

U9.ex: 轉述聽到的消息、別人說過的話：主詞 ＋ heard that／said that ＋ 一整句話。過去的事那句話也用過去式。
eg: Alice 聽說 Pam 買了一個新模型。
Paul 說他爸爸見到了國王。
我聽說他對爬蟲類有興趣。
U9.tip: that 可以省略：I heard he's interested in reptiles.

lines: Paul
Get out of the way, Susie!
Susie，閃開！
Susie
I'm trying, but I can't!
我正在試啊，但我沒辦法！
Paul
Watch out!
小心！
Susie
AHHH!!!!
啊！
Paul
Now I lost the race. Why didn't you move?
這下我輸了比賽。妳為什麼不動？
Susie
You know I'm not very good at skating. Anyway, you were going too fast.
你知道我不太擅長溜冰的。總之，你溜得太快了。
Paul
Sorry, I really wanted to beat Tim.
對不起，我真的很想打敗 Tim。
Susie
You could have hurt me. This skating rink is for everyone, not just you and Tim.
你可能會傷到我耶。這個溜冰場是大家的，不是只有你和 Tim 可以用。
Paul
Yeah, you're right. I'll try to skate more carefully.
是，妳是對的。我會試著更小心地溜冰。
phrases: 叫別人讓路，很急的時候用（有點不客氣）
看到危險，馬上提醒別人
換個話題，或說出最重要的那句話
build: I really wanted to beat Tim.
I'll try to skate more carefully.

lines: Becky
Hey, Pam. What's going on?
嘿，Pam。怎麼回事？
Pam
I'm cleaning out my closet. A lot of my clothes are too small for me. Mom said that you should pick out the ones you like.
我正在清理衣櫥。很多衣服對我而言都太小了。媽媽說妳應該挑選一些妳喜歡的。
Becky
Really? You're going to give them to me?
真的嗎？妳要把它們給我？
Pam
If you want them.
如果妳要的話。
Becky
Sure. Wow, this dress looks really cute.
當然。哇，這件洋裝看起來真可愛。
Pam
Yeah, but there's a hole in the sleeve.
對啊，但袖子有一個破洞。
Becky
That's OK. My mom's good at sewing things.
沒關係。我媽媽很擅長縫紉。
Pam
It'll probably fit you. Try it on.
它可能會適合妳。試穿一下。
Pam
Becky, you look great! There's more in this pile for you to try. When you're finished, you can take the rest home to Kate.
Becky，妳看起來很漂亮！這疊還有更多衣服讓妳試穿。妳試穿完後，可以將其他的帶回家給 Kate。
Becky
Thanks, Pam! This is lots of fun!
Pam，謝謝妳！這好有趣！
phrases: 看到別人在忙，想知道發生什麼事
too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ for 某人
build: My mom's good at sewing things.

lines: Tim
Whew! Today must be the hottest day so far this summer.
唷！到目前為止今天一定是這個夏天最熱的一天。
Wally
Yeah, I'm thirsty already. Let's stop at that convenience store for a drink.
是啊，我已經口渴了。我們在那家便利商店停一下，喝點東西。
Tim
Good idea.
好主意。
Tim
I got an iced tea. What'd you get?
我拿了一瓶冰茶。你拿了什麼？
Wally
Milk tea, and this. It's a new candy bar.
奶茶和這個。這是新的糖果棒。
Wally
Aw, I don't have enough money. Can you lend me twenty dollars?
噢，我的錢不夠。你可以借我二十元嗎？
Tim
I don't know, Wally. You still owe me ten dollars from last week. You should pay me back before I lend any more money to you.
Wally，我不確定。上週你還欠我十元。你應該在我借更多錢給你之前先還我錢。
Wally
You're right. Here's your ten, then.
你是對的。既然這樣，你的十元。
Tim
Thanks.
謝謝。
Wally
You're welcome. Now, can I borrow thirty dollars?
不客氣。現在，我可以借三十元嗎？
build: Can you lend me twenty dollars?
You still owe me ten dollars.

lines: Alice
My king, there's a terrible red dragon above the castle!
國王，城堡上方有一隻可怕的紅色的龍！
Chuck
Quick! Tell my knights and archers! Get ready to attack!
快！告訴我的武士們和弓箭手！準備攻擊！
Chuck
Archers, raise your bows. Ready, attack!
弓箭手，舉高你們的弓。預備，攻擊！
Alice
Oh, Chuck! You messed up your lines again. You forgot to say, "Knights, draw your swords."
噢，Chuck！你又搞錯台詞了。你忘了說：「武士們，拔劍。」
Chuck
Sorry, acting is really hard.
對不起，演戲真難。
Alice
No, it's not. You didn't learn your lines well enough. Look at your script.
不，不難。你沒背熟台詞。看你的劇本。
Chuck
OK, OK. I'm ready now. Let's try again.
好，好。現在我準備好了。我們再試一次。
Chuck
Knights, raise your bows! Archers, draw your swords!
武士們，舉高你們的弓。弓箭手，拔劍！
Alice
No, Chuck! That's still wrong. Give me the crown! If you don't want to take this seriously, then I'll be the king.
不對，Chuck！那樣還是錯。王冠給我，如果你不認真排練，我就要演國王了。
phrases: 失敗了，鼓勵大家再來一次
叫別人不要隨便、要認真

lines: Jimmy
Becky. Becky! Stop watching TV. Will you play "Wizard's Fight" with Kate and me? Pleeeaaase?
Becky，Becky！不要看電視了。妳要跟我和 Kate 玩「巫師大戰」嗎？拜託？
Becky
Oh, all right. You two can team up against me.
噢，好吧。你們兩個可以組隊跟我對抗。
Jimmy
OK! I'll attack first! Take my fireball spell, Becky!
好！我先攻！Becky，接我的火球咒。
Becky
Ha, ha, ha! It won't work on me. I cast a water wall spell, and it will protect me from fire.
哈哈哈！對我沒效，我施了水牆咒，它會保護我不受火擊。
Kate
Water? How about this ice spell? It will freeze you in the water!
水？這冰咒如何？它會讓妳在水裡結成冰！
Becky
Silly little wizard. I have a magic mirror, and your spell bounced back. Now, you and Jimmy are both frozen.
傻小巫師。我有魔鏡，妳的咒語彈回去了。現在，妳和 Jimmy 都結凍了。
Jimmy
Hey! That's not fair! You can't just freeze us with a magic mirror!
嘿！不公平！妳不能用魔鏡冰凍我們。
Becky
You can't talk, you're both frozen. Now, I'm going to watch TV.
你們不能說話，你們兩個冰凍了。現在我要去看電視了。
phrases: 提出另一個辦法：How about this ice spell?
build: It will protect me from fire.

lines: Susie
Wow, there's a lot of neat stuff here in Grandpa's attic.
哇，爺爺的閣樓裡有好多好棒的東西喔。
Chuck
Yeah, check this out. It looks like a magic lamp. You know what happens when you rub a magic lamp, don't you?
對啊，妳看這個。看起來像神燈。妳知道擦一擦神燈會發生什麼事，對吧？
Susie
Of course, a genie will pop out and give you three wishes.
當然，一個精靈會蹦出來並給你三個願望。
Chuck
That's right! I'm going to rub it and make my dreams come true!
沒錯！我來把它擦一擦使我的願望實現！
Susie
I don't know, Chuck. Sometimes genies trick people. If your wishes are too good to be true, something bad might happen.
Chuck，我不知道。有時精靈會捉弄人。如果你的願望太過美好，可能會發生不好的事。
Chuck
Don't worry. I'll be careful when I choose my wishes. Here goes!
別擔心。選擇願望時我會小心。開始囉！
Susie
Chuck! Is that really a genie behind the dust?
Chuck！灰塵後的那個真的是一個精靈嗎？
Chuck
I . . . I . . . don't know. I'm not sure . . .
我…我…我不知道。我不確定…
Susie
That's not a genie! It's Grandpa!
那不是精靈！是爺爺！
Grandpa
What are you kids doing? You're supposed to be helping me clean!
你們這些孩子在做什麼？你們應該在幫我打掃！
phrases: 叫別人看你發現的東西
要做一件有點緊張的事之前說
提醒別人本來該做的事
build: It looks like a magic lamp.
I'll be careful when I choose my wishes.

lines: Tim
Hey! You can't cut in front of me. Get back in line.
嘿！你不能在我前面插隊。去後面排隊。
Bully
Oh, yeah? Who's going to make me? You?
哦，是嗎？誰敢要我排隊？你？
Tim
Well, no.
嗯，不是。
Bully
That's what I thought. Now, get out of my way, shrimp.
我想也是。現在，軟腳蝦，滾開。
Alice
Hey, don't shove him!
嘿，不要推他！
Bully
Who are you?
你是誰？
Alice
I'm his sister. Those are your parents over there, right? Well, you'd better apologize to my brother, or I'll tell them what you did.
我是他姊姊。在那裡的是你的父母，對吧？嗯，你最好向我弟弟道歉，否則我會告訴他們你做的事。
Bully
Please . . . don't . . . Hey, I'm sorry.
拜託…不要…嘿，對不起。
Tim
It's OK.
沒關係。
Alice
Now, get back in line, and don't do it again.
現在，回去排隊，不要再犯了。
phrases: 叫插隊的人回到隊伍裡
給警告：you had better ＋ 動詞
build: You can't cut in front of me.
You'd better apologize to my brother.

lines: Wally
Hi, Pam. What are you reading?
嗨，Pam。你在看什麼書？
Pam
A book about riddles and puzzles.
一本關於謎語和猜謎的書。
Wally
Cool, I love riddles. Give me one.
酷，我喜歡謎語。考我一題。
Pam
Sure. Here's an easy one. How many months have 28 days in them?
好呀。先來一題簡單的。有多少個月份有二十八天？
Wally
That's a piece of cake! Only February has 28 days in it.
真簡單！只有二月有二十八天。
Pam
Sorry, you're wrong! All 12 months have 28 days in them.
抱歉，你答錯了！十二個月全都有二十八天。
Wally
That was a trick question. Give me another one. I'll get this one right for sure.
那題很詐。再問我一題。這次我肯定會答對。
Pam
OK. Listen carefully. Mary's father has four children. Three are named Jan, Jen, and Jin. What is the fourth child's name?
好，仔細聽喔。Mary 的爸爸有四個小孩，有三個名字是 Jan、Jen 和 Jin。第四個小孩叫什麼名字？
Wally
Let's see . . . a, e, i . . . Jon. The fourth child must be Jon!
我想想… a、e、i… Jon。第四個小孩一定是 Jon！
Pam
Nope, wrong again. It's Mary.
不對，又錯了。答案是 Mary。
Wally
Ah! That was a tricky one. Give me another one.
噢！那題很詐。再問我一題。
phrases: 想答案的時候先說這句

lines: Paul
Hey, Wally. What did you get Chuck for his birthday?
嘿，Wally。你送 Chuck 什麼生日禮物？
Wally
I heard that he's interested in reptiles, so I got him a DVD about poisonous snakes. How about you?
我聽說他對爬蟲類有興趣，所以我買一片有關毒蛇的 DVD 要給他。你呢？
Paul
A model robot. See? You get to put it together yourself.
一個模型機器人。你看？你要自己組裝。
Wally
Cool. It says here you can paint it, too!
酷。這裡說你也可以將它塗上顏色。
Paul
Paint? Uh-oh, I didn't buy any paint. I sure hope he already has some.
塗顏色？糟糕，我沒有買任何顏料。我希望他已經有些顏料了。
Wally
Don't worry. If he doesn't have any, he can go buy some himself.
別擔心。如果他沒有，他可以自己去買一些。
Paul
I guess so. I just don't want him to hate my gift!
我想是吧。我只是不要他討厭我的禮物！
Wally
Relax. It's an awesome gift. I would love it if I were him.
放輕鬆。這是個很棒的禮物。如果我是他，我會愛死它。
phrases: 假設不可能的事，用 were
build: What did you get Chuck for his birthday?
He can go buy some himself.
I would love it if I were him.
